Existing feed settings are never overwritten. Duplicate URLs are skipped.
Background work is always left to Android\u2019s scheduler. Sync times are approximate and may be deferred by Doze or device battery policies.
All feeds are also refreshed at least once every 24 hours, subject to the same Wi-Fi and battery preferences.
Off by default. When enabled, IntelliRSS may connect to feeds that do not support HTTPS. HTTP traffic is unencrypted.
IntelliRSS uses WorkManager. Android may defer sync during Doze, low battery and manufacturer restrictions.
Turn notifications on or off for each publisher. Feeds keep syncing even when notifications are off. Set priority or Muted in feed settings.

One article can belong to multiple feeds. Source relationships are always retained. Duplicate detection uses canonical URLs, GUIDs, normalized titles, publisher and content hashes.
Show all publishers in the reader
Off by default. IntelliRSS only contacts the endpoint below when you explicitly request AI actions. No article is uploaded to a cloud service.
No accounts. No analytics. No advertising. Feed data, history and the archive are stored in app-private storage.
Delete all reading history? Archived content and bookmarks stay.
Delete every feed, article, bookmark, archive file and setting? This cannot be undone.
IntelliRSS is a local-first RSS/Atom reader. All subscriptions and archived reading are owned by you and stay on this device.
Backups are created locally from the database, archive, icons and preferences.
This replaces the current database, archive and preferences. IntelliRSS will close after the restore. Do not power off the device during the copy.

Rules can raise relevance, mute notifications, mark read, archive, or tag articles. Rules run in order; mute always wins over an enable action.

Higher rules run first. Use the arrows to reorder.
Priority keywords raise article relevance; muted keywords lower it and suppress notifications. Preferred topics add relevance and improve topic grouping.
